title: What percentage of female clients from districts with average salary above
question: What percentage of female clients from districts with average salary above 10,000 have made at least one credit card withdrawal (VYBER KARTOU) in 1998 with an amount below the average credit card withdrawal amount for that year?

prediction.sql:
WITH female_clients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.XCL_009 AS client_id
    FROM client c
    INNER JOIN district d ON c.XCL_012 = d.XCL_017
    WHERE c.XCL_010 = 'F'
      AND d.XCL_027 > 10000
),
avg_withdrawal_1998 AS (
    SELECT AVG(t.XCL_051) AS avg_amount
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.XCL_050 = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND STRFTIME('%Y', t.XCL_048) = '1998'
),
clients_with_low_withdrawal AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT fc.client_id
    FROM female_clients fc
    INNER JOIN disp dp ON fc.client_id = dp.XCL_014
    INNER JOIN account a ON dp.XCL_015 = a.XCL_001
    INNER JOIN trans t ON a.XCL_001 = t.XCL_047
    CROSS JOIN avg_withdrawal_1998 aw
    WHERE t.XCL_050 = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND STRFTIME('%Y', t.XCL_048) = '1998'
      AND t.XCL_051 < aw.avg_amount
)
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT cw.client_id) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT fc.client_id) AS percentage
FROM female_clients fc
LEFT JOIN clients_with_low_withdrawal cw ON fc.client_id = cw.client_id;

WITH female_clients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.XCL_009 AS client_id
    FROM client c
    INNER JOIN district d ON c.XCL_012 = d.XCL_017
    WHERE c.XCL_010 = 'F'
      AND d.XCL_027 > 10000
),
avg_withdrawal_1998 AS (
    SELECT AVG(t.XCL_051) AS avg_amount
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.XCL_050 = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND STRFTIME('%Y', t.XCL_048) = '1998'
),
clients_with_low_withdrawal AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT fc.client_id
    FROM female_clients fc
    INNER JOIN disp dp ON fc.client_id = dp.XCL_014
    INNER JOIN account a ON dp.XCL_015 = a.XCL_001
    INNER JOIN trans t ON a.XCL_001 = t.XCL_047
    CROSS JOIN avg_withdrawal_1998 aw
    WHERE t.XCL_050 = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND STRFTIME('%Y', t.XCL_048) = '1998'
      AND t.XCL_051 < aw.avg_amount
)
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT cw.client_id) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT fc.client_id) AS percentage
FROM female_clients fc
LEFT JOIN clients_with_low_withdrawal cw ON fc.client_id = cw.client_id;
